description: This file defines the interface for inter-process communication (IPC) with a file system monitor daemon in a Git environment, including function declarations for checking support, getting socket paths, querying daemon state, and sending commands.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__is_supported
methods.description: Checks if the built-in file system monitor daemon is supported on the current platform.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__get_path
methods.description: Returns the path to the IPC named pipe or Unix domain socket for the daemon, or NULL if not supported.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__get_state
methods.description: Determines whether the daemon process is active or listening.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__send_query
methods.description: Queries for changed files since a given token via the daemon using simple-ipc.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__send_command
methods.description: Sends a command verb to the daemon without attempting to start it.
